name: Card
description: Flexible content surface with white, gray, outlined and bottom-border styles.

semantics.nativeAttributes: Forward the target stack's native div attributes and events.
semantics.content: Render children as the card content without imposing heading or landmark semantics.

props.name: cardStyle
props.description: Visual treatment of the card surface.

accessibility: Keep the default div semantics unless the target application has a specific semantic container requirement.
Preserve the accessible semantics of headings, links and controls supplied as children.
Forward native attributes and custom classes according to the target framework.
adaptationRules: Implement Card as a reusable component in the target application's framework.
Map cardStyle to the target styling system without changing the four visual variants.
Use the target framework's native children or slot/content convention.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any other dependency solely for this component.
